verdict.rationale: Mercury supports event-driven automation via webhooks (transaction/balance-change events), approval-policy-gated disbursements, and community-confirmed auto-funding rules across accounts, letting users define conditions that trigger downstream actions. However, this is not a unified no-code 'rules engine' — it requires combining webhooks with external logic or relying on built-in approval/auto-funding features rather than a general-purpose trigger-action builder. Missing for 10: a native flexible rules/automation builder spanning arbitrary triggers and actions, and independent evidence of AI-native users actually building custom event-triggered automations.
